info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API provides a comprehensive list of partners associated with hotel loyalty points programs. It enables users to query and discover various partners that enhance loyalty offerings and create value for travelers. This API is designed for hotel systems and travel platforms that want to integrate and display partner information to their users. Typical consumers include travel agencies, booking platforms, and hotels seeking to enhance customer loyalty through partnerships.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of business partners associated with points.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about the various business partners linked to points. It provides relevant information useful for managing partnerships and improving user engagement.
